title: Cost Model API (SCM) — Release Checklist (staged rollout)
content:
Doc owner: Connor O’Brien (Release Coordination)
Last reviewed with: Benji (flags), Sean (SLO/oncall), Rafael (canary/alerts), Chloe (Console), Hassan/Yara (Optimize), Logan (telemetry), Security (Aisha)

Purpose
- Provide a single operational checklist for releasing the Standard Cost Model (SCM) Cost Model API and enabling Console + Optimize dependencies with minimal customer impact.
- This is NOT a billing launch. SCM outputs must not be used as invoice source of truth.

Definitions / shorthand
- SCM: Standard Cost Model
- Cost Model API: service endpoints used by Console/Optimize for estimate + explain/attribution
- “Estimate”: deterministic calculation given inputs (may include assumptions)
- “Explain”: returns breakdown + contributing factors, plus assumptions/confidence
- “Metered attribution”: derived from runtime telemetry (if/when available); may arrive delayed
- Flag names (canonical):
  - cost_model_api.enabled (service enabled in region)
  - cost_model_api.allowlist_tenants (staged enablement)
  - console.cost_breakdown.use_scm (Console reads SCM)
  - optimize.what_if.use_scm (Optimize scenario sweeps via SCM)
  - cost_model_api.audit_logging.enabled
  - cost_model_api.strict_validation (reject missing required fields vs fallback assumptions)

Release owner responsibilities (RACI)
- Release owner (Connor): run checklist, declare go/no-go, schedule windows, coordinate comms, ensure rollback plan.
- Platform owner (Priya/Ethan): service deployment + capacity.
- Flags/config (Benji): create flags, manage allowlists, maintain rollback toggles.
- SRE (Sean/Rafael): dashboards, alerts, incident response readiness.
- Telemetry (Logan/Nadia/Thomas): signal availability + cardinality controls.
- Security (Aisha/Marcus/Kevin): audit logging + access controls review.

Pre-flight (T-7 days to T-1 day)
1) Change inventory / version
- [ ] Confirm SCM schema version targeted for rollout: scm_version=v1
- [ ] Confirm version negotiation behavior validated in staging:
  - Client requests v2 => server responds with v1 + warning header (until v2 exists)
  - Unsupported version => explicit error code (no silent downgrade) when client marks version as “required”
- [ ] Confirm deterministic requirement: same request payload => byte-for-byte same response (excluding request_id/trace_id)
- [ ] Confirm public/internal docs updated (internal): field names, units, assumptions/confidence semantics

2) Dependencies / infra readiness
- [ ] Cost Model API service deployed to all target regions (hosted + dedicated control plane regions as applicable)
- [ ] Service config points to correct model-catalog + hardware SKU tables
- [ ] Internal cache behavior reviewed (no cross-tenant data leakage, cache keys include tenant + version + region + model + quant profile id)
- [ ] Capacity check: target p95 latency under load; confirm load test baseline exists (see PR-18641)

3) Telemetry + data plumbing readiness
- [ ] Runtime emits required counters/timers in at least 1 prod canary cell:
  - prefill_tokens, decode_tokens (or equivalent)
  - prefill_time_ms, decode_time_ms (if used)
  - batch_size_effective
  - kv_cache_hit_rate (and definition is consistent)
  - quant_profile_id / quant_profile_family
  - gpu_sku, region, model_id, route_id (as permitted)
- [ ] Telemetry pipeline dimension policy confirmed (cardinality controls):
  - route_id aggregation policy agreed (e.g., hashed/bucketed or top-K only)
  - tenant_id not exposed outside allowed sinks
- [ ] Backfill behavior documented for missing tags during rolling restarts

4) Security/compliance sign-offs
- [ ] Audit event schema finalized and reviewed (read events, explain calls)
- [ ] Audit logging enabled flag exists and defaults OFF in non-prod? (confirm desired default)
- [ ] RBAC: who can call explain/attribution at customer granularity (Console service principals only; internal tooling requires elevated role)
- [ ] Redaction rules reviewed: no prompts, no raw request text in audit logs

5) Client integration readiness
Console
- [ ] Console backend client timeout/retry policy reviewed:
  - Timeout: 500ms default, 1 retry with jitter, max 2 attempts
  - Fallback: show “Estimated cost unavailable” state (no page failure) + use cached prior values if present
- [ ] UI copy reviewed for “Estimated”, “Assumptions”, “Confidence”
- [ ] Console caches responses appropriately (per-tenant + per-route + per-window) and respects version
Optimize
- [ ] Optimize scenario sweep limits in place (prevent unbounded what-if requests)
- [ ] Guardrail: suppress recommendations when confidence < threshold OR assumptions include “missing_telemetry_major”

6) Observability readiness (must be done before enabling any tenant)
Dashboards
- [ ] Service dashboard exists per region:
  - RPS, error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/mem, cache hit ratio
- [ ] Dependency dashboards:
  - Console breakdown page: SCM call rate, SCM errors, fallback rate
  - Optimize: what-if sweep success rate, time spent in SCM
- [ ] Mismatch detector dashboard exists (estimated vs metered attribution drift on fixed canary prompt set)
Alerts
- [ ] Paging alerts configured (SRE):
  - Availability / 5xx spikes
  - p99 latency above threshold for 10m
  - Validation error spikes (e.g., missing region/gpu_sku)
  - Drift alerts from perf canary (sustained mismatch)
Runbooks
- [ ] Runbook links in dashboard for:
  - timeouts causing Console degradation
  - high validation rejects after client change
  - drift/mismatch investigation

7) Data correctness checks in staging
- [ ] Golden request suite: fixed set of payloads with expected outputs (or expected invariants)
  - Invariants include: total = sum(breakdown components), units consistent, confidence within [0,1]
- [ ] Determinism test: same payload repeated 100x => identical cost numbers and identical breakdown ordering
- [ ] Version negotiation test: v1/vLatest accepted_versions behavior works

8) Rollback plan readiness (written + tested)
- [ ] Hard stop switch: console.cost_breakdown.use_scm OFF globally
- [ ] Hard stop switch: optimize.what_if.use_scm OFF globally
- [ ] Service isolation switch: cost_model_api.allowlist_tenants cleared
- [ ] If service is degraded: reduce traffic by region (route weights) OR disable explain endpoint if it’s the cause
- [ ] Document how to revert strict_validation to soft mode in emergency (with audit note)


Launch day checklist (T=0)
0) Release kickoff (15 min)
- Attendees: Connor (lead), Benji, Sean, Rafael, Chloe, Logan, Jordan
- [ ] Confirm change window and on-call coverage (platform + SRE + Console)
- [ ] Confirm current error budgets healthy (no ongoing incidents)
- [ ] Confirm flags starting state (all OFF except baseline service enablement if already deployed)

1) Deploy / verify service
- [ ] Deploy cost-model-service to prod (if not already present)
- [ ] Smoke test (per region):
  - POST /estimate returns 200
  - POST /explain returns 200 (for internal test tenant)
  - Unsupported version returns expected error code
  - Authz denied for non-Console principal
- [ ] Verify audit events are emitted for test calls (if audit logging enabled)

2) Enable service gradually (no clients yet)
- [ ] Turn on cost_model_api.enabled in 1 region (lowest traffic) for internal traffic only
- [ ] Verify:
  - latency within target
  - error rate < 0.5%
  - no unexpected cardinality explosion

3) Canary tenant rollout (Console first)
- [ ] Add 1–3 internal/canary tenants to cost_model_api.allowlist_tenants
- [ ] Enable console.cost_breakdown.use_scm for the same tenants
- [ ] Validate Console page behavior:
  - breakdown renders
  - assumptions tooltips populated
  - fallback state does not trigger for healthy calls
- [ ] Observe for 30–60 min:
  - Console fallback rate < 1%
  - SCM p95 < target
  - validation rejects minimal

4) Expand allowlist (external small cohort)
- [ ] Add small external cohort (e.g., 10 tenants) with known high engagement + low risk
- [ ] Send proactive note to Support about cohort (template below)
- [ ] Monitor 2 hours

5) Optimize enablement (after Console stable)
- [ ] Enable optimize.what_if.use_scm for internal only first
- [ ] Validate:
  - sweep runtime doesn’t regress
  - recommendations not suppressed unexpectedly (confidence thresholds)
- [ ] Expand Optimize cohort (if gated) after 24h stable Console

6) General availability within Redwood (still not billing)
- [ ] Expand allowlist to 25% tenants
- [ ] Expand to 50% tenants next business day if stable
- [ ] Expand to 100% tenants after 3–5 days stable + SRE sign-off


Gating criteria (go/no-go)
Hard no-go (do not proceed past canary)
- p99 latency > target for 30m in canary region
- Error rate > 1% sustained for 15m (excluding explicit client misuse)
- Console page degradation (increased 5xx or elevated latency attributable to SCM)
- Audit logging missing/incorrect for explain calls when enabled

Soft no-go (pause, fix, then resume)
- Validation rejects spike due to missing region/gpu_sku fields
- Drift/mismatch detector indicates >X% deviation for fixed prompt set (requires investigation; see mismatch runbook)

Success criteria (first week)
- Console: <0.5% of requests fall back due to SCM unavailability/timeouts
- SCM service: availability >= 99.9% (regional), no paging storm
- Confidence semantics: low-confidence responses are rare and explained (no silent “unknown”)


Migrations / config changes (track here)
- Service config
  - [ ] Confirm pricing tables / normalization constants deployed with version stamp (scm_constants_rev)
  - [ ] Confirm model-catalog metadata includes gpu_sku + quant_profile_id mapping
- Telemetry pipeline
  - [ ] Dimension additions deployed with limits (Thomas)
  - [ ] Validate new series volume within budget
- Client config
  - [ ] Console client timeouts + retries set
  - [ ] Optimize sweep limits set (max scenarios per request, max concurrent calls)


Smoke tests (copy/paste)
NOTE: Use internal test tenant only. Do not paste customer IDs in shared channels.

Estimate
- Request: model_id, region, gpu_sku, input_tokens, output_tokens, batch_size_effective, kv_cache_hit_rate, quant_profile_id
- Expect: 200, total_cost_usd > 0, breakdown sums to total, confidence present

Explain
- Expect: includes assumptions[] and contributing_factors[]; no prompt text echoed; request_id present

Negative tests
- Missing required fields => 400 with error code INVALID_ARGUMENT (or equivalent)
- Requesting unsupported scm_version with required flag => 409/400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (as per conventions)


Comms templates
1) #eng-platform / #eng-releases (internal launch update)
Subject: SCM Cost Model API staged rollout starting <date>
Body:
- Starting staged rollout of Cost Model API (SCM v1) to support Console cost breakdown + Optimize what-if.
- Scope: technical estimates + attribution explainability ONLY. Not used for invoices.
- Plan:
  - Day 0: internal/canary tenants in <region>
  - Day 1–3: expand allowlist to 25% → 50% → 100% (if stable)
- Oncall: SRE (Sean/Rafael). Release owner: Connor. Flags: Benji.
- Known failure mode: Console may show “Estimated cost unavailable” if SCM times out; this is expected fallback behavior.

2) Support enablement note (internal)
Subject: Heads-up: Console cost breakdown powered by SCM (estimated + assumptions)
Body:
- Some tenants will begin seeing a more detailed cost breakdown labeled “Estimated”.
- If customers report discrepancies, ask for:
  - tenant, region, model, time window, whether batching/caching enabled
- Use SCM “explain” output (internal) to identify assumptions/confidence.
- Escalation path: #eng-platform + ticket INT-xxxx.

3) Incident update snippet (if rollback)
- We are rolling back Console’s SCM dependency by turning OFF console.cost_breakdown.use_scm due to elevated latency/errors.
- Customer impact: cost breakdown may be missing or stale; core inference unaffected.
- Next update in 30 minutes.


Post-launch (T+1 day, T+1 week)
T+1 day
- [ ] Review dashboards: latency, error rate, validation errors, fallback rate
- [ ] Review audit logs sampling for correctness
- [ ] Check mismatch detector trend; file follow-ups if drift found
- [ ] Capture learnings + any hotfix PRs

T+1 week
- [ ] Retro: what went well/what didn’t, update this checklist
- [ ] Confirm decision on moving from allowlist to default-on for Console/Optimize
- [ ] Confirm backlog items for vNext (multi-scenario endpoint, expanded cost components, improved metered attribution)


Open questions (keep short; resolve before 100% rollout)
- Do we default strict_validation ON for all tenants, or keep soft mode with assumptions for missing region/gpu_sku?
- What is the official confidence threshold for Optimize suppression (0.7? 0.8?), and do we need per-model overrides?
- What drift threshold pages SRE vs creates a ticket?

Changelog
- 2025-02-10: initial draft (Connor)
- 2025-02-22: added gating criteria + comms templates (Benji/Sean)
- 2025-03-05: updated smoke tests + clarified rollback flags (Rafael/Chloe)
